summary: Recorded a bounded behavior about the runtime's drop-oldest egress policy: outgoing_buf also carries client-origin messages (core ProposalForward from plain follower appends, runtime TaggedProposal and Assigned), and neither layer resends those, so past the buffer cap the oldest client proposal can be lost even though the configuration doc justifies dropping via OmniPaxos resend. Framed as a behavior with the caller's drain duty bounding applicability, not as a defect claim. Four source anchors added; all five explained findings and the protection records remain unchanged.
